CONF1.question: A closed, rigid transparent plastic sphere of 10 m diameter with a 1 cm wall (wall density 1.19 g/cm3) is fully submerged in water of density 1.00 g/cm3 and filled with an organic liquid of density 0.86 g/cm3. The wall can withstand a net vertical load of at most 60 kg per cubic metre of contained volume, whatever the restraint. Counting the wall's own weight, does the net vertical load on the filled sphere stay within this limit? End your answer with one line: VERDICT: YES or VERDICT: NO.
